column1: Yes sir, Officer. Here are all of the car rental agreements for the last week.
column2: 「是的，警官。這是上週所有的租車合約。」

column1: The Top Hat representative slowly hands you the car rental agreements.
column2: 高帽代表慢慢把租車合約交給你。

column1: You carefully look over each car rental agreement. Unable to find anything helpful, you return them to the agent.
column2: 你仔細查看每份租車合約。找不到有用的內容後，便把合約還給租車員。

column1: What? snaps the agent. "I'm not going to show our rental agreements to you. They're confidential!"
column2: 「什麼？」租車員怒道。「我不會把租車合約給你看，那是機密！」

column1: You flash your badge at the Top Hat agent and he says... "Oh No! Is my boss in trouble again?"
column2: 你向高帽租車員亮出警徽，他說……「喔，不！我的老闆又惹麻煩了嗎？」

column1: You whip out your badge...
column2: 你迅速掏出警徽……

column1: What did I do? asks the agent. "The last wrong thing I remember doing was running a stop sign, and that was six years ago."
column2: 租車員問：「我做了什麼？」他說：「我記得上次做錯事是闖紅燈，那已經是六年前了。」

column1: The agent looks at the mug shot and says..."What a mean- looking fellow. Fortunately, I've never seen him before."
column2: 租車員看著嫌犯照片說……「真是個凶惡的傢伙。幸好我以前沒見過他。」

column1: You show the mug shot of Bains..."Nope, I've never seen the man before, but he sure looks like he ought to be locked up."
column2: 你出示班恩斯的嫌犯照片……「沒有，我以前從沒見過這個人，但他看起來確實該被關起來。」

column1: The rental agent takes a good look at the picture, and slowly responds..."Yeah, buddy, you've got a fine looking wife there. She needs a shave, though."
column2: 租車員仔細看了照片，慢慢回答……「是啊，老兄，你老婆長得真好看。不過她該刮鬍子了。」

column1: Anytime, Officer.
column2: 「隨時為您效勞，警官。」

column1: Sure hope you get this guy. He looks BAD!
column2: 「真希望你能抓到這傢伙。他看起來很糟！」

column1: You're welcome. Come again to... Top Hat!
column2: 「不客氣。歡迎再來……高帽！」

column1: You left the water running in the sink.
column2: 你讓洗手台的水一直流著。

column1: Whoosh-clink-ssss clink-sshh-glugg.
column2: 嘩啦——喀——嘶，喀——嘶——咕嚕。

column1: Whooooooooosssssshhhhh...... gurgle, gurgle.
column2: 呼——嘶——……咕嚕，咕嚕。

column1: Your arms aren't nearly long enough.
column2: 你的手臂遠遠不夠長。

column1: You aren't close enough.
column2: 你離得不夠近。

column1: The ground is outside. In the new, modern Lytton Airport, they've put in floors.
column2: 地面在外面。新式現代化的萊頓機場裡，鋪設了地板。

column1: If this was an "R" rated program like "Leisure Suit Larry", we might show it to you, but....!
column2: 如果這是像《拉瑞西裝》那樣的「R 級」遊戲，我們或許會給你看，但……！

column1: There are no bathroom drawings out here.
column2: 外面沒有浴室示意圖。

column1: The stall is furnished with a stool for your sitting pleasure and toilet paper for your comfort.
column2: 廁所隔間裡有方便你坐下的凳子，還有讓你舒適的衛生紙。

column1: There seems to be some graffiti scrawled on the wall of the stall... You can just barely read it.
column2: 隔間牆上似乎塗著一些塗鴉……你勉強看得出來。

column1: On the walls, you see a paper towel dispenser, an electric hand dryer, a mirror, and a vent mounted above the stalls.
column2: 牆上有紙巾 dispenser、電動烘手機、鏡子，以及裝在隔間上方的通風口。

column1: The toilet water is unappetizing.
column2: 馬桶裡的水令人倒胃口。
